notes.title: Patch notes 0.815 Fixes and various changes/improvements.
notes.content:
Implementing some bug fixes and updating some features. 

[previewyoutube=SX_jd8yt3so;full][/previewyoutube]

* The Anomaly Transmitter
         A machine attached to a wall has been added to all the islands in the backrooms. This can be traced by the compass and can be turned off and on. Playtester were confused as to what the compass was pointing to so the transmitter was added to fix that problem. 

* The Gate Changes. 
           The Gate has had the door moved to the side and some new textures and meshes were added to help the room stand out more. The button and starter items were moved closer together and on the opposite side of the door to better present the items that can be picked up. 

* The Lab Changes
           The unbuildable area that includes the shop among other things have been moved to the rear of the lab. This should make the lab feel more open. 

* Pick up animations
           If an item is hovered over by your mouse cursor then the Hazmat hand will reach for the item informing the player that it can be picked up. 

* Icons for UI
           The UI center image was a series of dots in the shape of a circle. this has been changed to custom images changing based on what you hover over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/cba6f34f20e319c1ee2fd6b37ef58fa42f7973e6.png[/img]

* Animation changes
            The Running animation was updated and the camera sways just a bit more. Camera sway was also added to the player in labs.

* Camera changes
             Play testers were confused on what photos they should take so the camera now raises  based on how close you are to a photoset spot.

* Options menu
     Motion blur off/on, Talking text sound Toggle, Mouse Sens, Controls menu. Your previous saved options apply on launch. 

* Optimization Changes.
     Generation has been optimized and changed so you dont fall through the map. 

* Sound/UI.
      Sound when moving an item has been added depending on what storage its being transferred to. Sound has also been added to picking up items based on where the item is sent. Backpack or hands. 

* Bug fixes.
     - No white screen appears when the world regenerates.  instead the screen blurs.
     - Floating items are no longer appearing in the backrooms.
     - Options now save and apply at start of game.
     - The research bench menu does not freeze the game when ESC is pressed.
     - Vents will no longer allow you to stand.
     - Saferoom button will now always spawn.
     - Tutorial Tips will stop the player running.
     - ESC Menu Un pauses now
 
*  General Changes

      - Backpack unlocked default slots have changed from  2 -> 4
      - Options button added to the hazmat ESC menu,
      - A flashing effect has been added to the camera that will grow bigger based on how close you are to a picture.

notes.title: Maintenance update 0.81
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/5d45da1c9ae4a178580b060f3fca650284f269ae.png[/img]

* Fixed Generation of Wonder islands. 
       ( Wonder Islands spawned too far into the backrooms. This change will increase the chance of them spawning near the start.)

* One Shot Profits now accepts photos.
           ( Photos are the easiest way to make money but the profit machine rarely spawned. to combat this, the one shot profit will accept photos but will lock after accepting them. Also there spawn rate has decreased slightly.  1.0% -> 0.8% chance to spawn on wall.)

* Savings that cover the cost of upkeep will no longer warrant a warning. 
            ( The warning system punishing the player after taking the money from their savings was an oversight. Now when your savings cover the upkeep, it will take away a warning.)

* Generation Tweaks
             (After the 3rd generation, The world under your feet would de-spawn and have you sent back to the lab without warning. Now the generation will only delete tiles that are far away rather then close.)

* Life Form AI 
              ( The Life Form AI now walks instead of standing in place. The time to evade its eyes has been increased from 7 to 10s. Remember your flashers.)

* Anomaly Scanner Range Increase
               ( The scanner has its range increased to find Anomaly's farther away into the backrooms.)

* Optimization 
                (Each tile had two light sources. it has been decreased to 1 so the game should be easier to run.)

* Corrupt button / Refresh Generation
                  ( Generation can be jump started by hitting the inventory tab button. (Refresh Generation).

* Favor Quest Section now bigger for text.
* Power Usage is reset every run.  (Still testing for permanent fix)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/450ced09c74817f099aed93cd7f2e125178e31bd.png[/img]

Future Changes = 
* POOL ROOMS REDONE
* PORTALS TO WONDER LEVELS MADE
* EVENT HALL WONDER ISLAND
* MIC STAND AND SOUND PLAYER. 
* Hiding options.
* Safe and Power options.

notes.title: Preview of patch 0.8 Sooner then you think
notes.content:
Hello again from the depths of CIEB. Im here to announce that the update is 80% done.  The lab is almost fully furnished and the backrooms are look better then ever. Lets look at what's changed. 

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
OLD GAMEPLAY
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/ff7853db3d2b96708fdc78266364be0837a397ad.png[/img]
NEW GAMEPLAY
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/45c8510c918dfc2732ca7cedfaf9cb84679f64bc.jpg[/img]

The new gameplay is going to change how the game works in a fundamental way.  One of them being that the UI has actually taken a backseat and only be visible when the information is needed. For example scrolling through your inventory will show your 3 items on your belt. The play button has been removed and replaced with a REC text with a timer under it. The Inventory also got remade to fit in the backrooms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/2399c89ba3bd398709f63daf7429b6ca7b600f3d.jpg[/img]

This inventory should feel better then the old computer screen and the clipboard has some attachments on the upper right side.  The Pace Marker will beep when you travel a certain distance. If you reset the marker then you will leave a sticker on the ground and gain 500$ profit, A nifty monster detector is also right under it. it will update in real time on how close a hostile enemy is near. 

[b]Favors[/b]

Gary has joined the lower level of the new elevator gate.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/f40109253e36deb8c21f882fd1cc5a3a75ba65f6.jpg[/img]

You will exchange certain items for favors. The favors will range from a free battery station at every safe room to keys for the golf cart.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/1da0d18f64f12fd52f29402beb983b3160ebbf8b.jpg[/img]

[b]Backrooms[/b]

The Backrooms itself went through a major change. I was able to get the generation to be 3x as big. This means no more pop ins from loading tiles. instead a seamless entrance to a never ending backrooms adventure can begin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/6cde9b37471f0173dee72699877048a3b7969c8d.jpg[/img]

The poolrooms and other levels have taken a backseat for now as i was focusing on improving the generation code but now the code is finished and Ill be showing more soon. I will probably update when im close to 95% done. 

[b]The Lab[/b]

The lab is finished. Here is the final look of the lab. in all its glory.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/bbe5dcf3aca065029940ab5f73c25a17a338ca4c.jpg[/img]

The lab will have adjacent rooms that aren't ready yet. This includes a office, Extra building space and a trophy room/simulation lab.

[b]New Items[/b]

The first new item is the Flash Trap. Place the flashtrap against the wall and wait for a monster to trigger it. It will stun the monster with a flash of light and take a picture. You can see gameplay of it in the YouTube video below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NEw1Wpksrbw&t=2s

EMP Ball is a ball that is ether white or black. If the EMP ball is white. it will offer power for 6 seconds of any electronic in a 6 feet radius. If black, it will fry the electronic. This could be useful for hiding in the dark or creating a safe space in the backrooms.

The Extension Cord. This cord is spawned in the backrooms next to a generator and will power anything with a wall socket as long as power is sufficient. Below is a reddit post of the item being used.

https://www.reddit.com/r/backrooms/comments/1b8gony/power_within_the_backrooms_can_be_used_to_power/

[b]Entities[/b]

The spider will be spawning in the backrooms and will most likely be sleeping. Best not to disturb it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/5af167cdff996b9a917059c10d659184c5df7a25.png[/img]

The mannequin is almost done and the hunter is in its very early stage. I doubt the hunter will be in the next patch but ill try to make it a reality, 

[b]Whats left[/b]

Well The spider AI is in shambles. I have 3 more levels to model and implement and the progression system overhaul is almost done. Other then that, the biggest thing left is the new tutorial. 

The update will come soon but for now enjoy the spring sale with a discounted price. If any of you feel like getting the game at a cheaper price. It would be now. Ill go back to working on the update. See you soon.

notes.title: Patch .43 will be coming later this month. (patch delay)
notes.content:
-------------------------[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/2f30831b4c67bcff94fee233b4d2f0b4f95ae804.png[/img]------------------------

The new patch wont come out till later this month. I hope it comes before the 20th but I have no way of knowing as this patch will incorporate the use of newly made features. I was going to keep adding things little by little to then make the overall game but I see that I need time to make features that change the game overall. I cant do that by implementing smaller patches sidelining the features that would improve the experience. The game is in a rough state. I know this. The resource storage does not save or store newly bought materials and the game is just not in a state im happy with.  

I want this game to be focused on exploration and wonder rather then the roguelike I advertised it to be. That is not to say that I am abandoning that aspect of the game. far from it actually. I need to make the core game fun to explore. the backrooms are the main character of the game.  So im going to keep my head under the hood and get to work.  Thank you for supporting the game.

notes.title: Patch 0.38 is HERE! (Smiler Rework, Skinner, Safe room and more!.
notes.content:
----------------------------------[b]Patch 0.38[/b]---------------------------------------
                                       [b] Halloween Relaunch Update[/b]
-------------------------------------[b] Features[/b] ---------------------------------------

[b]Smiler Rework[/b]
	The smiler has a new face!(Rather a new body). It is better designed and its AI has been overhauled for unique interactions. It cant stand light so run for an area of the backrooms that's lit to evade it. if you feel like you cant outrun it to the light then bring out your flasher for a temporary stun. Also it doesn't like to make it self known so you wont see it unless it smells some pheromones in the air. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/32c49b0648910ac64c768a75f0fe6db0a9523256.png[/img]
[b]Backrooms Rebuilt[/b]
	The Backrooms seemed a little too big and gave a feeling of safety. not what I was going for so I redid the textures and messed with the lighting to give it a more secluded feel. I also added a bunch of effects to the camera to mimic that of a body cam and vhs camera all in one go. You can see the difference below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/e28db018d6253c75cd02a18d767ddbe0308c1198.png[/img]

[b]Safe room and Stairs[/b]
	Running back and forth is no fun. to rectify this problem. safe rooms will now spawn throughout the 
backrooms. This room will provide you with a random item, A battery station, and a proof Submission cart. This way, you wont have to run back and forth unless you are close.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/071b64e44a04cfd737378155dd828bbe67015e1b.png[/img]
[b]Battery Station [/b]
	A quick little wall mounted station that will replenish your battery. it only spawns in the safe rooms for now but I will add it to the things that can spawn against walls next patch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/b3523218f0ec6c434aab89e437876f132bf607c5.png[/img]
[b]Skinner[/b]
	The Skinner is now in the backrooms once again with a victim. I would not come to close to her while she's eating or when she's roaming the halls. The flasher does work on this monster as having one eye sunken in soo much made her quite sensitive to sudden bursts of light. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/c989ebe8429da07ba2128030082de6cc973d94a6.png[/img]
[b]UI REDESIGN[/b]
	The UI Was all the same and did not vary in color. I opted to redesign it from top to bottom. below are some examples of the old UI and the new UI. (Not every UI has been updated. Ill slowly get them all.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/b2c3e1e727d2a46647049844bdec4d3a83572f9c.png[/img]

[b]Halloween Festive[/b]
	Festive decorations has been added to the labs. HAPPY HALLOWEEN.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/a38fb559a620d5e92785a2f4d3172738d943e42c.png[/img]

[b]Note From Dev[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/c3b2877662d9538f08b358791be447ed32070c63.png[/img]
	This has been the biggest patch yet. I've been working hard to layout the groundwork for future levels as well. The safe room and stairs were the first test on whether the generation can be broken for a certain area. If it wasn't then multiple areas would spawn on top each other crashing the game or causing lag. Im happy to say that it didn't. it works as intended. giving me room to make other levels such as the poolrooms and other big areas. With the system I put in place. I could spawn in entire mall complexes and not sacrifice fps or the generation. 

	Now for the broken promises. The warehouse is not ready nor will it be ready anytime soon. The smiler remake took much longer then I thought and took up the majority of the time. At first it wasn't going to be anything fancy but with the system now in place. I can make it into something much bigger. What im saying is that its going to take a while. In the meantime I will add more items, buildings, game mechanics and other things ill go into further detail later down this patch. I am thinking of adding the poolrooms next since the textures are the same and all I would have to do is worry about the lighting and layout but ill keep you posted on the discord. 

	For future, I want this game to reward exploring rather then punishing. The safe rooms was a step towards that by giving you a way to rest your feet and take a quick break but i want it to go further then that. The next item will be a radar that marks different areas such as safe rooms, stairs and other anomalies and guide you to it. but the next tier of items will be focused on camping in the backrooms and having the layout change around you. what do you think about things like this in terms of the game going in this direction. Let me know in discord or in the forums.

Thank you for supporting C.I.E.B The Backrooms Project.

-------------------------------Patch .35-----------------------------------

	Alright so lets get the big thing out of the way. The new level is going great.
It should be ready next week with alot more bug fixes and a smiler remake. Regarding this
patch, A lot of thought went into how to make the game more easy to understand. I added some new

written on the wall and the machine inside the room has been replaced with a big door with a exit sign.

A circle should also appear if your near an object you can interact with. A lot of bug fixes as well.

The next update will be content driven for both new ways to make money and the new level.

notes.title: Patch 0.33 is here! Quality of life Changes and bug fixes.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550871/d948494ae1fa393a21a143817549b0030956f2e1.png[/img]

--------------------------------Short Message------------------------------------------

So the game launched in a not so good state. I've been told that the game is hard to follow and has multiple issues with clipping.
Some things can't be found even when testing your own game. Even with other play testers. Things can fall through the cracks. 
I know now that I was telling them how to play and was not letting the game speak for itself. I added UI Elements to combat
this problem. I also add a few things to make the game feel smoother. Entity spawn's are fairly low as well. some monsters are clipping
Through the floor so they have been disabled until I can fix them. (Skull Spider, Skinner, and Face stealer.)

This was a pretty bad launch with how apparent these issues seem so I apologize in advance.
I am dedicated to making this game better from top to bottom. 

--------------------------------Future Content Update----------------------------------

While I am fixing these things. The next Content update will come in two weeks. This update will feature.

-A new Level

-A new buildings

-More things to find in the backrooms

-UI Redesign

-New Entity

-Smiler Remake.

-New building (Fast Door Exit)-- 

-----------------------------------PATCH NOTES---------------------------------------- 

*Fixed the link room animation

*Added sound to UI and items.

*Added the info box to main pause menu (Lore/How to Guides)

*Color coded the UI Inventory windows.

*Added Free Upgrade body to base. 

*Added UI to better explain the Game and Actions that are available to you.

*Added input to inventory screen so "Tab" exits it as well.

*Fixed some bugs with saving progress. i.e. Buildings still appearing though not saved.

*Fixed Bug that made it possible for player to have "Negative Funds"

*Added Hazmat inventory window to Lab Chest. 

*Added UI popups to help explain in tutorial.

*Monsters can no longer spawn near the entrance of the backrooms.
